name: runner-images
one_liner: The official recipe files that define exactly what software comes pre-installed on GitHub's cloud build machines — pure developer infrastructure, not a product.
buyer: No direct buyer; this is GitHub's own internal tooling shared publicly, useful only to people building or debugging their own custom CI runners.
business_use_cases: A DevOps consultancy references it to build custom self-hosted CI runner images matching GitHub's environment exactly.
A CI/CD tooling company uses it as the baseline spec when building a competing hosted-runner product.

money_ideas.idea: DevOps consulting building custom CI runner images for companies with specialized build requirements.

steal_this: Not a product opportunity — this is reference infrastructure, useful background reading for a DevOps consultant but not a thing to build a business around.
